facts.text: Reuse of evidence across machine models may be the single most important lever for a product family, but only if designed in from the start.
facts.quote: For a product family this may be the single most important lever, but only if designed in from the start.

facts.text: Reusable evidence across machine models can plausibly include unchanged safety software, common ECU hardware, communication interfaces, sensor intrinsic qualification, diagnostic logic, common scenario definitions and common requirements.
facts.quote: Reusable evidence can plausibly include unchanged safety software, common ECU hardware, communication interfaces, sensor intrinsic qualification, diagnostic logic, common scenario definitions and common requirements.

facts.text: Product-line safety research has developed reusable assurance-case structures to support reuse of evidence across machine models.
facts.quote: Product-line safety research has developed reusable assurance-case structures for exactly this purpose.

facts.text: The standard J1939 intervention interface in ISO/TS 21815-2 is an off-road precedent for reuse of evidence across machine models.
MSHA's PIL I12-V-19 provides a route for adding a proximity detection system to an already approved machine through an extension of approval or RAMP, and is an off-road precedent for evidence reuse.
facts.quote: MSHA's PIL I12-V-19 route for adding a proximity detection system to an already approved machine (extension of approval or RAMP) are the off-road precedents.

facts.text: Automatic collision braking is unusually sensitive to the boundary between machine variants.
facts.quote: Automatic collision braking is unusually sensitive to the variant boundary.

facts.text: Changing machine variants can change sensor height, pitch, yaw and occlusion; machine width, length and swept envelope; articulation or swing; maximum speed; gross mass and payload; brake and retarder architecture; stopping response and latency; tyre or track to ground behaviour; visibility around attachments; vibration; and power and network integration.
facts.quote: A different machine can change sensor height, pitch, yaw and occlusion; machine width, length and swept envelope; articulation or swing; maximum speed; gross mass and payload; brake and retarder architecture; stopping response and latency;

facts.text: A defensible evidence-reuse model for automatic collision braking uses common-core evidence plus explicit delta evidence, rather than blanket family qualification.
facts.quote: The defensible model is common-core evidence plus explicit delta evidence, not blanket family qualification.

facts.text: A rigorous machine-variant validation strategy identifies equivalence classes and selects physical representatives at credible worst cases.
facts.quote: A rigorous variant strategy identifies equivalence classes and selects physical representatives at credible worst cases;

facts.text: Several physical machine representatives may be needed for variant validation because the machine with the worst stopping distance is not necessarily the machine with the worst sensor occlusion.
facts.quote: the machine with the worst stopping distance is not necessarily the one with the worst sensor occlusion, so several representatives may be needed.

facts.text: No published method was found for transferring perception evidence across sensor mounting positions.
facts.quote: No published method was found for transferring perception evidence across sensor mounting positions

facts.text: No case was found in which evidence inheritance reduced validation of a large heavy-machine family from years to months.
facts.quote: no case was found in which such inheritance reduced validation of a large heavy-machine family from years to months.
